## [§1.1.b] The CAC problem & introducing CFA

So, here's the problem this book solves. Most advertising isn't profitable, AKA, people lose money getting customers. And so let me explain how this works. Let's say you make a thousand dollars in profit per customer over their lifetime. So this would be a lifetime gross profit of a thousand bucks. And it costs you a hundred dollars to get a customer.
